info.title: Konklav control plane
info.description: The Konklav server: subject-facing, relying and control-plane HTTP surfaces

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/credentials/{id}/break-glass`: marks a local password or secret
key as a break-glass credential, whose every use appends
`break_glass.used`.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/credentials/{id}/replace`: replaces a password with a new
credential that records what it replaces. Sessions established with the
old one end.

`POST /v1/credentials/{id}/revoke`: revokes the credential and ends the
sessions established with it.

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/credentials/{id}/session-flags`: sets the restrictive session
flags every session started with the credential carries.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/credentials/{id}/slots/{slot}/rotate`: sets a new secret for
one slot of a secret key. The other slot keeps working, so clients can
switch over without downtime.

requestBody.description: Optional; without it the new secret never expires

200.description: Rotated. The slot's new secret is in `secret_key`, shown only once.
Already existed with the same content

post.summary:
`POST /v1/memberships/{id}/end`: ends the membership and the sessions
targeting it.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only sessions neither revoked nor expired.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: A login identifier (email address, phone number or key id).

200.description: Already existed with the same kind

201.description: Created. A secret key's secrets are in `secret_keys`, shown only once.

post.summary: Disables the subject and ends its sessions.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/subjects/{id}/entitlements?tenant=`: what a subject is
entitled to, for operators.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant (a UUID or `root`); global entitlements only when absent.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/subjects/{id}/explain?tenant=&action=`: which assignments and
policies bear on an action, and where it ends up granted.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant (a UUID or `root`); global roles only when absent.

200.description: Already existed with the same content

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/tenants/{tenant}/roles/{key}`: creates or replaces a role.
Roles of the root tenant are global roles.

`PUT /v1/tenants/{id}/state`: leaving `active` ends every session
targeting the tenant.

ActionExplanation.description: Why one required action at one level is granted or not.

contributions.description: Every policy that bears on the action, wherever it lands.

oneOf.description: The tenant owning the scope, when it is another tenant's.

role.description:
The role's key in the membership's tenant (or in root for global
assignments).

oneOf.description:
Where in the tenant the role applies; tenant-wide when absent.
Global assignments have none.
A tenant role, for a membership in the role's tenant.

id.description: A tenant role, for a membership in the role's tenant.

oneOf.description: A global role, for a subject directly.

id.description: A global role, for a subject directly.

AssignmentTarget.description: Who a role is assigned to.

Check.description: One check a decision makes besides the required actions.

ClientKind.description: Whether the session's refresh token travels in a cookie or in bodies.

Contribution.description: One policy that bears on an action, and where it lands.

policy.description: The policy's action or group, as written.

oneOf.description: With either `password` or an Argon2id `password_hash`.
Log in with a magic link sent to `identifier`, an email address.
Log in with a code sent to `identifier`, an E.164 phone number.

A workload identity at an identity provider: tokens it issues for
`subject` sign the service principal in with the JWT bearer grant.

parent.description: The parent tenant (a UUID or `root`); `root` when absent.

templates.description: Templates to instantiate roles from, atomically with the tenant.

CreatedCredential.description: A new credential, with a secret key's secrets.

oneOf.description: For secret keys: both slots' `<key id>.<secret>`, shown only once.

Credential.description: A credential without any secret material.

oneOf.description: For passkeys.
For secret keys.

CredentialId.description:
Identifies a credential. For secret keys it is also the login
identifier.

Cursor.description:
The position of an event in the change feed.

Cursors increase strictly with every event but may have gaps, so they are
only meaningful for ordering and resuming, never for counting.

obligations.description: One per share the decision relied on.

oneOf.description: The caller may succeed after re-authenticating as described.

DecisionExplanation.description: Why a decision allows or denies.

allowed.description: Whether every check passes and every required action is granted.

oneOf.description:
The decision the check API would reach, when explaining for a
session.

deleted.description:
Whether this call deleted it; `false` when there was nothing to
delete.

oneOf.description: The token doesn't verify, or its session has ended or moved on.
The session carries a restrictive flag the operation doesn't admit.

restricted_session.description: The session carries a restrictive flag the operation doesn't admit.

oneOf.description: The session lacks an assertive flag the operation requires.

missing_flag.description: The session lacks an assertive flag the operation requires.

oneOf.description: Tenant or scope requirements, but the token targets no tenant.

A required registered scope was never recorded, has been removed,
or isn't in the tenant the requirement names.

unknown_scope.description:
A required registered scope was never recorded, has been removed,
or isn't in the tenant the requirement names.

Entitlements.description:
Effective allows for one subject in one tenant. Denies are already
resolved, and an action granted at a higher level is not repeated below.

scoped.description: Actions granted at one scope each, as a list.

shared.description: Other tenants' scopes shared with this tenant.

message.description: For humans; it may change between releases.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error codes. Never rename a variant: add a new
one instead.

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response.

at.description:
The time to explain the decision as of, as RFC 3339; now when
absent. Needs history, and can't be combined with a session.

oneOf.description:
One of the subject's sessions, to check authentication as its tokens
would be checked.

tenant.description: The tenant to decide in; the session's when absent.

Explanation.description: Why a subject has (or lacks) an action.

granted_at.description: The levels where the action ends up granted.

portable.description: Whether the fact may be copied into tokens.

FactTarget.description: What a fact is attached to.

FactType.description: The type of a fact's value.

FlagKind.description:
A restrictive flag denies the session everywhere except operations that
admit it; an assertive flag is a statement operations can require.

oneOf.description: Exactly these actions.

Every catalog name (actions and groups) not starting with one of
these prefixes.

all_except_prefixes.description:
Every catalog name (actions and groups) not starting with one of
these prefixes.

GroupEntry.description: A declared action group and how it expands.

managed_by.description: The identity provider whose claim mapping created it, if any.

MembershipDetail.description: A membership with its role assignments.

MembershipId.description: Identifies a membership of one subject in one tenant.

Obligation.description:
A share's attributes, for the relying system to apply to an allowed
operation: Konklav doesn't interpret them.

tenant.description: The owner tenant of the shared scope.

Policy.description: One rule of a role or template.

scope_bound.description: Applies only at the assignment's scope; otherwise tenant-wide.

PutRole.description: What a role should look like.

priority.description:
Between policies for the same action at the same level, the higher
priority wins; at equal priority, a deny wins.

template.description: The key of a template to derive from.

PutTemplate.description: What a template should look like.

oneOf.description: A policy allows it at a level that counts, and wins there.

ineffective.description:
Denies that don't cancel it: outranked where it wins, or at other
levels.

oneOf.description: No level that counts grants it, and a deny wins at one of them.

overrides.description: The allows at the deny's level that it overrides.

oneOf.description: No level that counts grants it, but these scopes do.
No policy grants it anywhere.
The other tenant's scope isn't shared with this tenant.
The share doesn't allow the action.

The share allows it, but the subject doesn't hold it at the
recipient.

Reason.description: Why a required action is granted or not.

oneOf.description: The new credential's id; generated when absent.

RequestedClaims.description:
Single claims an OIDC client asked for with the `claims` request
parameter.

Requirements.description: What an operation demands of the caller.

admit_flags.description: Restrictive session flags this operation tolerates.

global.description: Actions required globally (independent of any tenant).

require_flags.description: Assertive session flags this operation needs.

scopes.description: Actions required at scopes of the token's tenant.

tenant.description: Actions required tenant-wide in the token's tenant.

token_kinds.description: Accepted token kinds; `tenant` only when absent.

reason.description: Recorded as the revocation reason; `revoked` when absent.

oneOf.description: A session to leave alone even if it matches.

reason.description: Recorded as the revocation reason; `revoked_by_operator` when absent.

RevokeSessions.description: Revokes the sessions a filter matches; it must set at least one field.

revoked.description: Whether this call revoked it; `false` when it already was.

Role.description: A role: tenant-local, or global when the root tenant owns it.

builtin.description: Defined by Konklav, under a reserved key; it can't be written.

policies.description: The role's own policies, which override its template's.

template.description: The key of the template the role derives from.

managed_by.description: The identity provider whose claim mapping created it, if any.

RotatedSlot.description: A secret key after one slot's rotation, with that slot's new secret.

secret_key.description: The slot's new `<key id>.<secret>`, shown only once.

Scope.description: A resource inside a tenant. Konklav treats the id as opaque.

registered.description:
Scopes of this kind are registered scopes: requirements at them are
decided from Konklav's record of each scope.

ScopeRequirement.description:
Actions required at one scope. The relying system resolves its own
resources into scopes before asking, except registered scopes, which
it names alone.

oneOf.description:
The tenant that owns the scope, when it isn't the token's: then only
shares of the scope with the token's tenant satisfy it.

ScopedActions.description: The actions granted at one scope.

SecretKeySlot.description: One slot of a secret key, without its secret.

SecretKeySlots.description: Both slots of a secret key.

SecretSlot.description: One of the two independently rotatable slots of a secret key.

identity_claims.description:
Claims passed from the identity provider the session was started
through, by scope, until the session ends.

mfa_factors.description: MFA factors verified in this session.

oidc_claims.description: Single claims the client asked for, beyond its scopes' claims.

oidc_client_id.description: The OIDC client the session was started for, if any.

oidc_scopes.description: The scopes granted to that client.

oneOf.description:
The session this one was started from (impersonation); ending the
parent ends this one.

SessionFilter.description: Which sessions to act on. Every set field must match.

requestable.description: Restrictive flags only: whether a login request may ask for it.

oneOf.description: Pass as `before` to get the next page.

SessionStage.description:
How far a session has got: `partial` until MFA completes, `identity`
without a tenant, `tenant` with one.

ShareId.description:
Identifies a share of one tenant's scope with another tenant.
Callers supply it when offering the share.

Shared.description:
What a share grants one subject: the share's actions that the subject
holds at the recipient.

SigningKey.description: A key Konklav signs tokens with, without its key material.

StepUp.description: Stronger or fresher authentication an operation needs.

allowed_methods.description: Methods that count towards `min_methods`; any method when absent.

max_age_seconds.description: The last authentication must be at most this old.

min_methods.description: At least this many distinct authentication methods.

SubjectId.description: Identifies a subject for its whole lifetime.

SubjectKind.description: Whether a subject is a person or software.

Template.description: A reusable role blueprint, which can't be assigned.

TenantId.description:
Identifies a tenant. Callers may supply their own UUID v7 values when
creating tenants.

TokenKind.description: What an access token may be used for.
